name: Rakez Local

values.description: Base URL for local development. Change to staging/production URL as needed.
Sanctum Bearer token. Auto-populated by the Login request test script.
Sales unit search alert ID. Auto-populated by the Create Alert test script.
Contract ID (used as project_id — project_commission_settings and search alerts both reference contracts.id).
City ID from the cities table.
District ID from the districts table.
Unit type filter. Common values: villa, apartment, studio, duplex.
Test client mobile number. Use Saudi format (+966...) for production testing.
Test account email. Replace with a real seeded user email for your local DB.
Test account password. Replace with the actual password for your local DB user.

description:
Local development environment for RAKEZ ERP - Sales Unit Search Alerts.

Setup:
1. Import this file in Postman as an Environment.
2. Update test_email and test_password to match a seeded sales user.
3. Run the Login request first — auth_token will be set automatically.
4. Run Create Alert — alert_id will be set automatically.

Do NOT commit real credentials to version control.
